title: Notion Agent API credits_used and total_credits_used now return decimals and break integer-only code
symptoms: Integer parsing error or type mismatch on credits_used from Retrieve a session or Query sessions
total_credits_used from Retrieve agent insights does not equal the exact credit usage
Value such as 0.45 or 12.45 where whole numbers were expected
cause: Since October 30, 2026, credit fields report fractional credits and round down. credits_used has at most two decimals (12.456789 reads as 12.45). total_credits_used is a whole number from 1 up (12.7 reads as 12) and has at most two significant figures below 1 (0.456789 reads as 0.45).
fix: Treat these fields as floating point numbers, not integers. Do not sum rounded values and expect exact totals.
apply: const credits: number = Number(session.credits_used); // allow decimals, do not use parseInt
